0022600228.text: The Pistons (7-3, first in the Central and third in the East) are on a one-game winning streak and have won seven of their last ten, while the Wizards (3-7, 10th in the East) have lost four straight. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Ugonna Onyenso is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve). The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-111 win in Detroit on November 9, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
